question: In November 2021, who was appointed as Head Coach of the Indian cricket team (Senior Men)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rahul Dravid was appointed head coach of India men's cricket team, to take over from the New Zealand series starting November 17.
 
• Batting legend and former captain Rahul Dravid has been officially appointed as the new head coach of the Indian cricket team, the BCCI announced.
 
• Rahul Dravid will take over the new role and begin his tenure as India's full-time coach from the home T20I series against New Zealand starting November 17.
 
• Rahul Dravid replaced coach Ravi Shastri, whose stint comes to an end after the T20 World Cup. 
 
• Rahul Dravid was appointed as the head of the National Cricket Academy in 2019, a position which he will leave before taking over as India’s head coach.
 
• Before this, he was serving as the Head Coach for the India Under-19 and India A teams from 2016 to 2019.
 
• Under his mentorship, the India under-19 team was runners-up at the 2016 under-19 Cricket World Cup and winners at the 2018 u-19 Cricket World Cup. 
 
• Known as "The Wall' and Dependable, Dravid is widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• BCCI in India is the governing body for cricket in India. Its headquarters is situated at Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai.
 
• The role of BCCI is to regulate and overlook the growth and development of everything related to Indian cricket.
